description: This file contains the implementation of the MerchantConfigurationService interface, which manages merchant configuration data, including CRUD operations, retrieval of configuration objects, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the MerchantConfigurationService interface; manages merchant configuration CRUD operations, fetching configuration objects, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a merchant configuration by key and store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all merchant configurations for a given store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by type and store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a merchant configuration entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a merchant configuration by entity.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant configuration as a MerchantConfig object, parsing JSON stored in the database.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Saves a MerchantConfig object into the database, serializing it into JSON format.
